full_article:
Kathmandu, July 24: Nepal lost to Netherlands in yesterday's match under ICC Men's World Cup Cricket League-2. Nepal lost to the Netherlands by six wickets in the match held in Utrecht, Netherlands. This is Nepal's second consecutive defeat in this series.

In the first match on Thursday, Nepal was defeated by Namibia. Chasing the target of 158 runs given by Nepal, the Netherlands completed it by losing four wickets in 44.1 overs. Chasing a total of 158 runs, captain Scott Edwards remained victorious with 61 runs for the Netherlands. Similarly, Noah Cross remained unbeaten on 34 runs and led the team to victory. For Nepal, Sompal Kami, Dipendra Singh Airee and Lalit Rajbanshi took one wicket each.

After losing the toss, Nepal batted first and were all out for 157 runs in 44.4 overs. Arif Sheikh scored the highest 41 runs for Nepal. Gulsan Jha scored 29 and Dipendra Singh Airee contributed 21 runs. After the batsman got out cheaply, Nepal could not make a big total.

With this defeat, Nepal has lost an important point in League-2. Nepal has 24 points from 30 matches. Similarly, with this victory, the Netherlands scored 34 points in 29 games. Now Nepal will play its third match of the series against Namibia on Monday. (RSS)

description: Scott Edwards’ unbeaten 61 steers Netherlands past Nepal in Utrecht  SportsAdda
publisher.title: SportsAdda
full_article:
The Netherlands tightened their grip on the World Cup League 2 tri-series in Utrecht on Thursday, beating Nepal by six wickets after captain Scott Edwards guided the chase with an unbeaten 61. Set 158 to win, the hosts got home with more than five overs to spare and banked two more points, while Nepal slipped to a second straight loss on this away leg.

Nepal undone by another top-order stumble

Batting first, Nepal never built the platform their innings needed. Aasif Sheikh, Kushal Bhurtel, captain Rohit Paudel and Ishan Pandey all fell cheaply inside the first 12 overs, the captain out for just 3. Dipendra Singh Airee and Gulsan Jha added some substance with 21 and 29, and Aarif Sheikh’s laboured 41 off 90 balls was the top score, but the lower order folded quickly and Nepal were bowled out for 157.

Edwards holds the chase together

Any hope Nepal had of defending a modest total ran into Edwards. The wicketkeeper-captain batted through the innings for 61 not out off 89 balls, pacing the pursuit rather than forcing it, and found steady support from Noah Croes, who finished on 34 not out. Sandeep Lamichhane, Nepal’s most dangerous bowler, went wicketless for 36 as the Netherlands reached 158 for 4 in 44.1 overs. There was little alarm once Edwards settled, the target ticking down without the Nepal spinners ever building sustained pressure.

Qualifying stakes climb for Nepal

The result matters well beyond the scoreboard. League 2 feeds directly into the qualification pathway for the 2027 ODI World Cup, and every point weighs heavily for the Associate nations chasing a place. Nepal arrived on this leg sitting fifth in the table, and back-to-back defeats against Namibia and now the Netherlands have made an already hard road steeper. For the hosts, it was a controlled, unfussy win that keeps their own qualification account ticking over.

गुरुवार क॑ उट्रेच म॑ आयोजित विश्व कप लीग २ केरऽ त्रि-सीरीज प॑ नीदरलैंड न॑ अपनऽ पकड़ कड़ी करी क॑ कप्तान स्कॉट एडवर्ड्स न॑ अपराजित ६१ रन के साथ पीछा करै के मार्गदर्शन करला के बाद नेपाल क॑ ६ विकेट स॑ हरा देलकै ।जीत लेली १५८ रन बनाबै के साथ मेजबान टीम न॑ पाँच ओवर स॑ भी अधिक समय बची क॑ घर पहुँची गेलै आरू दू अंक आरू बैंक करलकै, जबकि नेपाल न॑ ई विदेशी लेग प॑ लगातार दोसरऽ हार प॑ फिसल गेलै ।

एकटा आओर टॉप-ऑर्डर ठोकर स नेपाल अनडन

पहिने बल्लेबाजी करैत नेपाल कहियो ओ प्लेटफॉर्म नहि बनौलक जेकर जरूरत अपन पारी मे छल । आसिफ शेख, कुशल भूर्टेल, कप्तान रोहित पौडेल आरू ईशान पांडेय सब पहलऽ १२ ओवर के भीतर सस्ता म॑ गिरी गेलै, कप्तान महज ३ ओवर के दूरी प॑ आउट होय गेलै ।दीपेंद्र सिंह ऐरी आरू गुलसन झा न॑ २१ आरू २९ रन के साथ कुछ पदार्थ जोड़लकै, आरू आरिफ शेख केरऽ श्रमसाध्य ४१ रन ९० गेंद प॑ शीर्ष स्कोर छेलै, लेकिन निचला क्रम गुना होय गेलै जल्दी आ नेपाल १५७ रन पर आउट भ गेल।

एडवर्ड्स चेस के एक संग पकड़ने अछि

नेपाल क॑ मामूली कुल के रक्षा करै के जे भी आशा छेलै, वू एडवर्ड्स स॑ टकरा गेलै । विकेटकीपर-कप्तान न॑ पारी के माध्यम स॑ ८९ गेंद प॑ ६१ नॉट आउट करी क॑ बल्लेबाजी करी क॑ ओकरा जबरदस्ती करै के बजाय पीछा करै के गति देलकै आरू नूह क्रोस केरऽ लगातार समर्थन मिललै, जेकरा न॑ ३४ रन प॑ नॉट आउट करी क॑ खतम करलकै । नेपाल केरऽ सबसें खतरनाक गेंदबाज संदीप लामिछाने ३६ रन प॑ विकेट रहित रहलै, जब॑ नीदरलैंड ४४.१ ओवर म॑ ४ विकेट प॑ १५८ रन प॑ पहुँची गेलै । एडवर्ड्स के बसला के बाद अलार्म कम भेलै, टारगेट टिक टिक डाउन भेलै, बिना नेपाल स्पिनर के कहियो लगातार दबाव बनेने।

नेपाल के लिये क्वालीफाइंग दांव चढ़े

स्कोरबोर्ड स काफी आगू परिणाम मायने रखैत अछि। लीग २ सीधे २०२७ केरऽ वनडे विश्व कप लेली क्वालीफाइंग मार्ग म॑ फीड करै छै, आरू हर अंक एक जगह के पीछा करै वाला एसोसिएट राष्ट्रऽ लेली भारी पड़ै छै । नेपाल तालिका में पांचम स्थान पर बैसल एहि लेग पर पहुंचल, आ नामीबिया आ आब नीदरलैंड के खिलाफ बैक-टू-बैक हार पहिने सं कठिन सड़क के खड़ा क देलक अछि. मेजबान टीम लेली ई एगो नियंत्रित, बेधड़क जीत छेलै जेकरा स॑ हुनकऽ अपनऽ क्वालीफाइंग खाता टिक-टिक करी रहलऽ छै ।

title: Nepal warned to ensure no China-criticisms during upcoming int’l Tibetan studies seminar - Tibetan Review

full_article:
(TibetanReview.net, Jul23’26) – The Chinese ambassador in Nepal has on Jul 21 knocked on the door of the latter’s Foreign Secretary and expressed concern about an international seminar on Tibetan studies scheduled to be held in capital Kathmandu late next month. The ambassador, Zhang Maoming, has told Amrit Bahadur Rai to ensure there will be no perceived China-criticisms by scholars in their presentations throughout the Aug 23-29 event, according to the Kathmandupost.com Jul 22.

The report cited a senior foreign ministry official as saying the Chinese envoy drew the attention of the foreign secretary and cautioned that the event could be used by supporters of the exiled Tibetan spiritual leader Dalai Lama.

The report cited the official as saying Zhang warned Rai that some individuals could speak against China and in support of Tibet, and urged officials to make sure that no such things happen.

Hundreds of researchers, scholars and experts on Tibetan studies, including Oxford and Cambridge, from some 39 countries are expected to gather at the 17th International Association of Tibetan Studies which will be organised jointly by the Himalaya Centre for Asian Studies, Kathmandu University; and the Kathmandu University Centre for Buddhist Studies at Rangjung Yeshe Institute.

In the backdrop of China’s recently adopted law on ethnic unity – a measure meant to assimilate China’s ethnic minority groups through penal measures, including against perceived critics in foreign countries – some Kathmandu-based individuals sympathetic to Beijing’s position on Tibet are stated to have also expressed concern over the event, saying promoting Tibetan language, culture and history could ultimately be interpreted as support for the Dalai Lama’s views.

The report cited the foreign ministry official as saying the Chinese ambassador, however, did not submit any written reservation or called for cancellation of the event.

Prof Sagar Sharma of Kathmandu University, who will convene the seminar with Prof Thomas Doctor, has said, “Its not a pro-Dalai Lama event. Huge numbers of Chinese professors and scholars are also attending. The Chinese embassy also knows about it. We have also informed different government agencies.”

The event’s opening Ceremony will be held at Kathmandu University’s Dhulikhel campus and the rest of the programmes will be held at Hotel Soaltee.

Formally established in 1979 at the University of Oxford, the International Association of Tibetan Studies operates as a non-political academic body dedicated to advancing research in Tibetan history, religion, linguistics, and art.

Its board members are Daniel Berounský (Czech Republic), Geshe Nyima Woser Choekhortshang Rinpoche (Nepal), Hildegard Diemberger (Austria), Dorji Wangchuk (Bhutan), Iwao Kazushi (Japan). Lama Jabb (UK), Pema Choedon (Norway), Karma Phuntsho (Bhutan), Françoise Pommaret (France), Jarmila Ptáčková (Czech Republic), Françoise Robin (France), Ulrike Roesler (UK) and Yudru Tsomu (China).

(TibetanReview.net, Jul23’26) – नेपाल मँ चीन केरौ राजदूत नँ 21 जुलाई क बाद वाला केरौ विदेश सचिव केरौ दरवाजा खटखटाय देलकै आरू अगिला महीना के अंत मँ राजधानी काठमांडू मँ आयोजित होलौ तिब्बती अध्ययन केरौ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संगोष्ठी के बारे मँ चिंता व्यक्त करलकै । राजदूत झांग माओमिंग न॑ अमृत बहादुर राय स॑ कहलकै कि ई सुनिश्चित करलऽ जाय कि पूरा २३-२९ अगस्त केरऽ आयोजन म॑ विद्वानऽ के प्रस्तुति म॑ चीन-आलोचना केरऽ अनुमान नै लगै ।

रिपोर्ट म॑ विदेश मंत्रालय केरऽ एगो वरिष्ठ अधिकारी के हवाला स॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै कि चीनी दूत न॑ विदेश सचिव के ध्यान आकर्षित करी क॑ चेतावनी देल॑ छै कि ई आयोजन के इस्तेमाल निर्वासित तिब्बती आध्यात्मिक नेता दलाई लामा के समर्थक करी सकै छै ।

रिपोर्ट म॑ अधिकारी के हवाला स॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै कि झांग न॑ राय क॑ चेतावनी देलकै कि कुछ व्यक्ति चीन के खिलाफ आरू तिब्बत के समर्थन म॑ बोल॑ सकै छै, आरू अधिकारियऽ स॑ आग्रह करल॑ छै कि ई सुनिश्चित करलऽ जाय कि ऐसनऽ कोय भी बात नै होय ।

ऑक्सफोर्ड आरू कैम्ब्रिज सहित तिब्बती अध्ययन केरऽ सैकड़ों शोधकर्ता, विद्वान आरू विशेषज्ञऽ के लगभग ३९ देशऽ के १७वीं इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन आफ तिब्बती अध्ययन म॑ जुटै के उम्मीद छै जेकरऽ आयोजन हिमालय सेंटर फॉर एशियन स्टडीज, काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा संयुक्त रूप स॑ करलऽ जैतै; आ रंगजंग येशे संस्थान मे काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय बौद्ध अध्ययन केन्द्र।

चीन न॑ हाल म॑ जातीय एकता प॑ अपनालऽ गेलऽ कानून के पृष्ठभूमि म॑ – जेकरऽ मतलब छै कि चीन केरऽ जातीय अल्पसंख्यक समूहऽ क॑ दंडात्मक उपाय के माध्यम स॑ आत्मसात करना छै, जेकरा म॑ विदेशी देशऽ म॑ कथित आलोचकऽ के खिलाफ भी शामिल छै – कहलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै कि तिब्बत प॑ बीजिंग केरऽ स्थिति स॑ सहानुभूति रखै वाला कुछ काठमांडू स्थित व्यक्ति न॑ भी ई आयोजन प॑ चिंता व्यक्त करी क॑ कहलकै कि तिब्बती भाषा, संस्कृति आरू इतिहास क॑ बढ़ावा दै के अंततः व्याख्या करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै दलाई लामा के विचार के समर्थन के रूप में |

रिपोर्ट म॑ विदेश मंत्रालय केरऽ अधिकारी के हवाला स॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै कि चीनी राजदूत न॑ हालांकि कोनो लिखित आरक्षण नै देलकै आरू नै ही आयोजन रद्द करै के आह्वान करलकै ।

प्रो थॉमस डॉक्टर के संग गोष्ठी के आह्वान करय वाला काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय के प्रो सागर शर्मा कहलखिन्ह जे, "ई दलाई लामा के समर्थक आयोजन नहि अछि. भारी संख्या मे चीनी प्रोफेसर आओर विद्वान सेहो शामिल भ रहल छथिन्ह. चीनी दूतावास के सेहो एहि बारे मे पता अछि. हम सभ अलग-अलग सरकारी एजेंसी के सेहो जानकारी देलहुं अछि."

आयोजन के उद्घाटन समारोह काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय के धुलिखेल परिसर में आ बाकी कार्यक्रम होटल सोलटी में होयत.

औपचारिक रूप स॑ १९७९ म॑ ऑक्सफोर्ड विश्वविद्यालय म॑ स्थापित, इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन आफ तिब्बती अध्ययन संघ, तिब्बती इतिहास, धर्म, भाषाविज्ञान, आरू कला म॑ शोध क॑ आगू बढ़ाबै लेली समर्पित एगो गैर-राजनीतिक शैक्षणिक निकाय के रूप म॑ काम करै छै ।

full_article:
By A Staff Reporter, Kathmandu, July 24: Nepal’s struggles with both bat and ball continued in the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2 Tri-series in Utrecht, as they fell to hosts Netherlands by six wickets on Thursday.

The Rhinos had earlier lost their opener against Namibia by eight wickets on 21 July. Back-to-back defeats have dented Nepal’s hopes of breaking into the top four, while even their place in the top six is now under threat.

Currently fifth, Nepal are tied with sixth-placed Namibia and seventh-placed Canada on 24 points, separated only by net run rate.

Put in to bat first at Sportpark Maarshalkerweerd, Nepal managed just 157 runs in 44.4 overs, setting the Dutch a modest target of 158.

The hosts chased it down comfortably, reaching 158/4 in 44.1 overs.

After the loss, captain Rohit Paudel admitted his side’s shortcomings:

“We batted very poorly. We failed as a batting unit and could not build big partnerships when needed most.

The bowling was also not up to the mark, as we could not restrict the opponents despite the modest score.”

Paudel added that he expects his team to make a strong comeback in the remaining two matches in the Netherlands.

Dutch skipper Scott Edwards played a captain’s knock, guiding his side to their 15th win in 29 matches. Netherlands, placed third, now have 34 points—four behind second-placed Scotland. Table-toppers USA lead with 43 points from 32 matches, while Oman sit fourth with 31 points from 28 games.

The Netherlands too had a shaky start, losing opener Max O’Dowd for 9 in the sixth over to Sompal Kami. Cedric de Lange (21 off 51) fell in the 15th over, followed by Bas de Leede (1) in the next, leaving the hosts reeling at 47/3.

Zach Lion-Cachet was run out for 21 in the 23rd over, reducing them to 73/4.

Edwards then steadied the innings with Noah Croes, adding an unbeaten 85-run stand for the fifth wicket to seal victory. Edwards struck a patient 61 off 89 balls, with two fours and a six, while Croes contributed 34 off 59 deliveries.

For Nepal, Sompal Kami, Dipendra Singh Airee, and Lalit Rajbanshi picked up a wicket apiece.

Earlier, Nepal’s batting faltered once again. Aasif Sheikh (14), Kushal Bhurtel (9), and Paudel (3) fell cheaply, while Ishan Pandey managed just 4.

Dipendra Singh Airee (21) and Aarif Sheikh (41) offered brief resistance, with Gulshan Jha (29) and Karan KC (13*). No partnership proved decisive.

In reply, the Dutch bowlers shared the spoils: Roelof van der Merwe and Alex Roy claimed three wickets each, Logan van Beek took two, and Kyle Klein added one.

Nepal now face Namibia on 27 July.

एकरऽ पहल॑ गैंडा न॑ नामीबिया के खिलाफ अपनऽ ओपनर मैच म॑ २१ जुलाई क॑ आठ विकेट स॑ हारलऽ छेलै । बैक-टू-बैक हार के कारण नेपाल के टॉप फोर में घुसय के उम्मीद खत्म भ गेल अछि, जखन कि टॉप छह में ओकर जगह तक आब खतरा में पड़ल अछि.

फिलहाल पांचम स्थान पर रहल नेपाल छठम स्थान पर रहल नामिबिया आ सातम स्थान पर रहल कनाडा के संग 24 अंक के बराबरी पर अछि, जे केवल नेट रन रेट के हिसाब सं अलग अछि.

स्पोर्टपार्क मार्शलकरवेर्ड म॑ बल्लेबाजी करै लेली पहलऽ स्थान प॑ रहलऽ नेपाल न॑ ४४.४ ओवर म॑ महज १५७ रन बनाबै म॑ सफल रहलै आरू डच टीम क॑ १५८ के मामूली लक्ष्य रखलकै ।

मेजबान टीम एकरा आराम स॑ पीछा करी क॑ ४४.१ ओवर म॑ १५८/४ के स्कोर प॑ पहुँची गेलै ।

हार के बाद कप्तान रोहित पौडेल न॑ अपनऽ टीम केरऽ कमी क॑ स्वीकार करी लेलकै :

ओ कहला जे हम सब बहुत खराब बल्लेबाजी केलहुं, हम बल्लेबाजी यूनिट क रूप मे फेल भेलहुं आ जखन बेसी जरूरत छल तखन पैघ साझेदारी नहि बना सकलहुं।

गेंदबाजी सेहो निशान पर नहि छल, किया कि मामूली स्कोर के बावजूद हम सब प्रतिद्वंदी के प्रतिबंधित नहि क सकलहुं।”

पौडेल न॑ आरू कहलकै कि हुनका उम्मीद छै कि नीदरलैंड म॑ बाकी दू मैच म॑ हुनकऽ टीम मजबूत वापसी करतै ।

डच कप्तान स्कॉट एडवर्ड्स न॑ कप्तान केरऽ नॉक खेली क॑ अपनऽ टीम क॑ २९ मैच म॑ १५वां जीत दिलैलकै । तेसर स्थान पर रहल नीदरलैंड के पास आब 34 अंक अछि – दोसर स्थान पर रहल स्कॉटलैंड सं चारि अंक पाछू. टेबल टॉपर यूएसए ३२ मैचऽ म॑ ४३ अंक के साथ बढ़त॑ छै, जबकि ओमान २८ मैचऽ स॑ ३१ अंक के साथ चारिम स्थान प॑ छै ।

नीदरलैंड केरऽ भी शुरुआत डगमगाय रहलऽ छेलै, जेकरा म॑ ओपनर मैक्स ओ’डाउड क॑ छठमऽ ओवर म॑ सोम्पल कामी स॑ ९ रन प॑ हारलऽ छेलै । 15वां ओवर में सेड्रिक डी लैंगे (51 रन पर 21) गिरी गेलै, जेकरा बाद अगिला ओवर में बास डी लीडे (1) गिरी गेलै, जेकरा चलतें मेजबान टीम 47/3 पर डगमगाय गेलै।

23वां ओवर में जैक लायन-कैचेट 21 रन के साथ रन आउट होय गेलै, जेकरा स॑ ओकरा 73/4 होय गेलै ।

एकरऽ बाद एडवर्ड्स न॑ नोआ क्रोस के साथ पारी क॑ स्थिर करी क॑ पाँचमऽ विकेट लेली ८५ रन के नाबाद स्टैंड जोड़तें हुअ॑ जीत प॑ मुहर लगाय देलकै । एडवर्ड्स न॑ ८९ गेंद प॑ मरीज ६१ रन बनैलकै, जेकरा म॑ दू चौका आरू एक छह रन बनैलकै, जबकि क्रोस न॑ ५९ गेंद प॑ ३४ रन के योगदान देलकै ।

नेपालक लेल सोम्पल कामी, दिपेन्द्र सिंह ऐरी, आ ललित राजबंशी एक-एकटा विकेट उठौलनि।

एहि सं पहिने नेपाल के बल्लेबाजी एक बेर फेर डगमगा गेल. आसिफ शेख (14), कुशल भूर्टेल (9), आ पौडेल (3) सस्ता मे गिरल, जखन कि ईशान पांडे महज 4 रन बनेबा मे सफल रहलाह।

दीपेन्द्र सिंह ऐरी (21) आरू आरिफ शेख (41) न॑ संक्षिप्त प्रतिरोध करलकै, जेकरा म॑ गुलशन झा (29) आरू करण केसी (13*) न॑ विरोध करलकै । कोनो साझेदारी निर्णायक साबित नहि भेल।

जवाब में डच गेंदबाज न॑ लूट के हिस्सा बंटैलकै : रोएलोफ वैन डेर मेरवे आरू एलेक्स रॉय न॑ तीन-तीन, लोगान वैन बीक न॑ दू विकेट लेलकै, आरू काइल क्लेन न॑ एक विकेट जोड़लकै ।

title: Nepal earns Rs. 29.32B from electricity exports - The Rising Nepal
description: Nepal earns Rs. 29.32B from electricity exports  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
By A Staff Reporter, Kathmandu, July 24: Nepal has achieved a historic milestone in cross-border electricity trade, earning a record Rs. 29.32 billion from electricity exports to India and Bangladesh during the fiscal year 2025/26.

According to the Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA), electricity export earnings increased by 67.96 per cent in the last fiscal year as compared to the previous fiscal year, driven by a sharp rise in export volumes and growing regional demand for Nepal's hydropower.

The NEA exported 3.877 billion units (kWh) of electricity during the review fiscal year, up 62.89 per cent from 2.383 billion units exported in fiscal year 2024/25.

Electricity was sold at an average price of Rs. 7.56 per unit through India's power exchanges—including the Indian Energy Exchange's Day-Ahead Market (IEX-DAM), Real-Time Market (IEX-RTM), and NVVN—as well as under the trilateral power trade arrangement with Bangladesh.

In the previous fiscal year, the country had earned Rs. 17.46 billion from electricity exports.

Meanwhile, the country's dependence on imported electricity declined significantly during the last fiscal year.

The electricity imports fell by 31.57 per cent to 1.15 billion units in fiscal year 2025/26 from 1.68 billion units a year earlier.

As a result, Nepal's electricity import bill dropped by 18.29 per cent to Rs. 10.56 billion, down from Rs. 12.92 billion in fiscal year 2024/25.

The higher export earnings coupled with lower import costs enabled the country to post a net electricity trade surplus of Rs. 18.76 billion during the review year.

In comparison, the net surplus stood at only Rs. 4.54 billion in fiscal year 2024/25, meaning the surplus increased by 313 per cent, or more than fourfold, during the review year.

The sharp rise in domestic hydropower generation, expansion of cross-border transmission infrastructure, and more effective energy management have enabled Nepal to establish itself as a strong, self-reliant, and profitable electricity exporter in South Asia.

एनईए न॑ समीक्षा वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान 3.877 अरब यूनिट (किलोवाट घंटा) बिजली के निर्यात करलकै, जे वित्तीय वर्ष 2024/25 म॑ निर्यात करलऽ गेलऽ 2.383 अरब यूनिट स॑ 62.89 प्रतिशत अधिक छै ।

बिजली औसतन 100 टका क दाम पर बिकायल। 7.56 प्रति इकाई भारत कें बिजली आदान-प्रदान कें माध्यम सं-जइ मे भारतीय ऊर्जा विनिमय कें दिन-पूर्व बाजार (आईईएक्स-डीएएम), रियल-टाइम बाजार (आईईएक्स-आरटीएम), आ एनवीवीएन शामिल छै-साथे-साथ बांग्लादेश कें साथ त्रिपक्षीय बिजली व्यापार व्यवस्था कें तहत.

पिछला वित्तीय वर्ष मे देश कए 100 टका क कमाई भेल छल। बिजली निर्यात स 17.46 अरब टका भेटल।

एहि बीच पिछला वित्तीय वर्ष क दौरान आयातित बिजली पर देश क निर्भरता मे काफी कमी आयल अछि।

वित्तीय वर्ष 2025/26 मे बिजली आयात 31.57 प्रतिशत घटि कए 1.15 अरब यूनिट भ गेल जे एक साल पहिने 1.68 अरब यूनिट छल।

एकरऽ परिणाम ई छेलै कि नेपाल केरऽ बिजली आयात बिल १८.२९ प्रतिशत घटी क॑ 100 रुपया होय गेलै । 10.56 अरब टका स कम अछि। वित्तीय वर्ष 2024/25 मे 12.92 अरब टका छल।

एकर तुलना मे शुद्ध अधिशेष मात्र 100 टका रहल। वित्तीय वर्ष 2024/25 मे 4.54 अरब क वृद्धि भेल, मतलब समीक्षा वर्ष क दौरान अधिशेष मे 313 प्रतिशत यानी चारि गुना स बेसी क वृद्धि भेल।

घरेलू जलविद्युत उत्पादन मे तीव्र वृद्धि, सीमा पार संचरण बुनियादी ढाँचा के विस्तार, आ अधिक प्रभावी ऊर्जा प्रबंधन के कारण नेपाल दक्षिण एशिया मे एकटा मजबूत, आत्मनिर्भर, आ लाभदायक बिजली निर्यातक के रूप मे अपना के स्थापित करय मे सक्षम भ गेल अछि.

title: DMLI prosecutes seven cases, seeks Rs 118 billion recovery - The Rising Nepal
description: DMLI prosecutes seven cases, seeks Rs 118 billion recovery  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, July 24: The Department of Money Laundering Investigation (DMLI) has prosecuted seven cases related to money laundering in the fiscal year 2082/83 BS.

As per the details published by the Department on Thursday, it made 121 individuals as defendants and sought recovery of Rs 118 billion in the cases.

Four investigation sections as well as Law and Consulting Unit, Administration and Plan Section, Investigation Coordination Section and Police Section are being placed at the Department for carrying out investigation and prosecution tasks. (RSS)

full_article:
India is the world's sixth-largest economy, with an economic output of around US$ 4.15 trillion. As economic activity and per capita income continue to rise, the number of Indians travelling abroad has also increased significantly. According to the Indian Ministry of Tourism, 32.7 million Indians travelled overseas in 2025, compared to 30.85 million in 2024. The most visited destinations were the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and Thailand.

These figures indicate that India has enormous potential as a source market for Nepal's tourism industry. According to the Nepal Tourism Board, 293,384 Indian tourists arrived in Nepal by air last year, while an estimated one million more entered the country through land border points. Among Indian visitors, Pashupatinath, Muktinath, Pokhara, and Manakamana remain the most popular destinations.

Related Articles Gurung heritage powers Lamjung's rural tourism economy Thori custom point reopens to Indian cars, reviving cross-border tourism

An analysis of the arrival trends of Indian tourists reveals a remarkable increase during Nepal's traditional tourism off-season. Many Indian travellers prefer travelling in their own vehicles, taking advantage of the easy road connectivity between the two countries during holiday periods. Nepal continues to be a preferred destination because of its cultural and linguistic similarities with India, easy accessibility, natural beauty, and affordable travel packages.

More recently, climate change has emerged as another factor encouraging Indians to visit Nepal. Rising temperatures across India, with mercury crossing 40°C in many states, have prompted travellers to seek cooler destinations during the summer months.

Against this backdrop, the growing preference among Indian tourists to visit Nepal as a refuge from rising temperatures presents a significant opportunity for Nepal's tourism sector. Traditionally, the country's tourism activity slows after the spring season. However, this year witnessed an unexpected surge in Indian arrivals during June, keeping tourism businesses unusually busy.

Hotels in major destinations such as Pokhara, Muktinath, and Manakamana have reported high occupancy rates, largely driven by Indian pilgrimage tourists. According to recent data from the Annapurna Conservation Area Project (ACAP), approximately 66,000 tourists visited Muktinath during May and June, of whom 94 percent were Indian nationals.

This encouraging trend reflects Nepal's sustained efforts to promote its tourism products through participation in travel fairs and tourism exhibitions across India. Such promotional campaigns have helped position Nepal as an attractive destination for Indian travellers.

Furthermore, popular hill stations in India such as Sikkim and Darjeeling receive heavy rainfall from mid-June onwards, often resulting in severe landslides and travel disruptions. In contrast, Nepal offers pleasant weather, spectacular mountain scenery, attractive off-season accommodation discounts, and relatively uncrowded cultural and historical attractions, making it an appealing alternative during the monsoon months.

The record number of visitors to Muktinath this year demonstrates its growing status as one of the most sought-after pilgrimage destinations for Indian tourists. Maintaining and effectively managing this increasing flow of visitors should therefore become a priority for policymakers and tourism stakeholders. Sustainable visitor management will be essential to retaining this momentum in the years ahead.

At the same time, Nepal should identify, develop, and promote other potential religious destinations capable of attracting Indian pilgrims. Marketing efforts should position Nepal not merely as a seasonal escape from extreme heat but as a year-round destination offering rich religious, cultural, natural, and adventure tourism experiences.

Recent reports in the media and on social media regarding the behaviour of some Indian tourists in public places have also highlighted the need to improve tourism infrastructure and visitor management. The number of Indian religious tourists is substantial, and many follow specific customs regarding food preparation, accommodation, water use, and religious practices. These cultural preferences deserve respect and should be accommodated wherever feasible.

Nepal should therefore prioritise investment in essential infrastructure at its most visited pilgrimage sites. This includes constructing pilgrim rest houses, improving transportation facilities, expanding public toilets, promoting quality guest houses and homestays, and ensuring access to clean drinking water and proper sanitation. Equally important is the establishment of clear operating procedures for public sites, supported by visible information on visitors' responsibilities, including appropriate dos and don'ts, to preserve the cleanliness and sanctity of these destinations.

Although many pilgrimage visitors travel on modest budgets, they contribute significantly to local economies through the purchase of religious items, handicrafts, souvenirs, groceries, food, and other local products. This spending directly benefits small businesses, creates local employment opportunities, and improves the livelihoods of grassroots communities. Increased tourist expenditure also generates higher government revenue, which can be reinvested in infrastructure development, heritage conservation, and the sustainable management of Nepal's religious tourism destinations.

As Indian outbound tourism continues to expand, Nepal is well positioned to benefit from its geographical proximity, cultural affinity, and natural attractions. By improving infrastructure, strengthening sustainable tourism practices, diversifying religious tourism products, and enhancing visitor management, Nepal can transform the growing influx of Indian tourists into a long-term driver of economic growth while preserving the country's unique natural and cultural heritage for future generations.

एकरऽ अलावा भारत केरऽ लोकप्रिय हिल स्टेशन जेना कि सिक्किम आरू दार्जिलिंग म॑ जून केरऽ मध्य स॑ भारी बारिश होय छै, जेकरऽ परिणामस्वरूप अक्सर भारी भूस्खलन आरू यात्रा म॑ बाधा पहुँचै छै । एकरऽ विपरीत नेपाल म॑ सुखद मौसम, शानदार पहाड़ी दृश्य, आकर्षक ऑफ-सीजन आवास छूट, आरू अपेक्षाकृत भीड़भाड़ वाला सांस्कृतिक आरू ऐतिहासिक आकर्षण छै, जेकरा स॑ मानसून के महीना म॑ ई एगो आकर्षक विकल्प बनी जाय छै ।

ई साल मुक्तिनाथ केरऽ रिकॉर्ड संख्या भारतीय पर्यटकऽ लेली सबसें जादा मांग वाला तीर्थस्थलऽ म॑ स॑ एक के रूप म॑ एकरऽ बढ़तऽ दर्जा क॑ दर्शाबै छै । अतः आगंतुकऽ के ई बढ़तऽ प्रवाह क॑ बनाए रखना आरू प्रभावी ढंग स॑ प्रबंधित करना नीति निर्माता आरू पर्यटन हितधारकऽ लेली प्राथमिकता बनना चाहियऽ । आबै वाला साल म॑ भी ई गति क॑ बरकरार रखै लेली टिकाऊ आगंतुक प्रबंधन बहुत जरूरी होतै ।

एकरऽ साथ ही नेपाल क॑ भारतीय तीर्थयात्री क॑ आकर्षित करै म॑ सक्षम अन्य संभावित धार्मिक स्थलऽ के पहचान, विकास, आरू प्रचार-प्रसार करना चाहियऽ । विपणन प्रयास नेपाल क॑ खाली अत्यधिक गर्मी स॑ मौसमी पलायन के रूप म॑ नै बल्कि साल भर के समृद्ध धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक, प्राकृतिक, आरू साहसिक पर्यटन के अनुभव प्रदान करै वाला गंतव्य के रूप म॑ स्थापित करै के चाही ।

मीडिया आरू सोशल मीडिया प॑ सार्वजनिक स्थानऽ प॑ कुछ भारतीय पर्यटकऽ के व्यवहार के संबंध म॑ हाल केरऽ रिपोर्ट म॑ भी पर्यटन केरऽ बुनियादी ढाँचा आरू आगंतुक प्रबंधन म॑ सुधार के जरूरत प॑ प्रकाश डाललऽ गेलऽ छै । भारतीय धार्मिक पर्यटकक संख्या पर्याप्त अछि, आ बहुतो भोजन तैयारी, आवास, जल उपयोग, आ धार्मिक प्रथाक संबंध में विशिष्ट रीति-रिवाजक पालन करैत छथि. ई सांस्कृतिक वरीयता सम्मानक पात्र अछि आ जतय संभव हो ओकरा समायोजित करबाक चाही ।

अतः नेपाल के अपन सबस बेसी देखल जाय वाला तीर्थ स्थल पर आवश्यक बुनियादी ढांचा में निवेश के प्राथमिकता देबाक चाही। एहि मे तीर्थयात्री विश्राम घरक निर्माण, परिवहन सुविधा मे सुधार, सार्वजनिक शौचालय कें विस्तार, गुणवत्तापूर्ण गेस्ट हाउस आ होमस्टे कें बढ़ावा देनाय, आ स्वच्छ पेयजल आ उचित स्वच्छता कें पहुंच सुनिश्चित करनाय शामिल छै. ओतबे महत्वपूर्ण छै सार्वजनिक स्थलक कें लेल स्पष्ट संचालन प्रक्रियाक कें स्थापना, जेकर समर्थन आगंतुकक कें जिम्मेदारियक कें दृश्यमान जानकारी सं होयत छै, जाहि मे उचित करय आ नहि करय कें काज शामिल छै, ताकि अइ गंतव्यक कें साफ-सफाई आ पवित्रता कें संरक्षण कैल जा सकय.

यद्यपि बहुतो तीर्थयात्रा आगंतुक मामूली बजट में यात्रा करैत छथि, मुदा धार्मिक वस्तु, हस्तशिल्प, स्मृति चिन्ह, किराना, भोजन, आ अन्य स्थानीय उत्पादक खरीद के माध्यम सं स्थानीय अर्थव्यवस्था में काफी योगदान दैत छथि. इ खर्च सं सीधा छोट व्यवसायक कें फायदा होयत छै, स्थानीय रोजगार कें अवसर पैदा होयत छै, आ जमीनी स्तर कें समुदायक कें आजीविका मे सुधार होयत छै. पर्यटकऽ के बढ़लऽ खर्च स॑ सरकारी राजस्व भी अधिक होय छै, जेकरा आधारभूत संरचना के विकास, धरोहर संरक्षण, आरू नेपाल केरऽ धार्मिक पर्यटन स्थलऽ के सतत प्रबंधन म॑ पुनर्निवेश करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ।

जेना-जेना भारतीय आउटबाउंड पर्यटन के विस्तार जारी छै, नेपाल अपनऽ भौगोलिक निकटता, सांस्कृतिक आत्मीयता, आरू प्राकृतिक आकर्षण स॑ लाभ उठाबै लेली अच्छा स्थिति म॑ छै । बुनियादी ढांचा में सुधार, टिकाऊ पर्यटन प्रथा के मजबूती, धार्मिक पर्यटन उत्पाद में विविधता, आरू आगंतुक प्रबंधन में वृद्धि करी क॑ नेपाल भारतीय पर्यटकऽ के बढ़तऽ आवागमन क॑ आर्थिक विकास केरऽ दीर्घकालिक चालक म॑ बदली सकै छै आरू साथ ही साथ देश केरऽ विशिष्ट प्राकृतिक आरू सांस्कृतिक धरोहर क॑ आबै वाला पीढ़ी लेली संरक्षित करी सकै छै ।

गुरुङ राष्ट्रिय योजना आयोगक पूर्व सदस्य छी, आ सिन्दुराकर नेपाल पर्वतारोहण संघक मुख्य प्रशासनिक अधिकारी छथि

title: Eight sued for fraud using Nepal Bal Sangathan land and budget - Ratopati
description: Eight sued for fraud using Nepal Bal Sangathan land and budget  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. A case has been filed in the Kathmandu District Court against 8 people on charges of fraud by misappropriating the land and government budget of Nepal Bal Sangathan (Bal Mandir) for personal gain.

The District Government Attorney's Office has filed a charge sheet accusing the then officials and employees of the organization of embezzling funds and assets that should have been used for the benefit of orphaned children. The case has been filed in the Kathmandu District Court on charges of fraud based on the investigation report conducted by the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) of the police.

Among those sued are Asha Shrestha, the then planning chief of Bal Mandir and currently a member of Kathmandu Metropolitan City Ward No. 11, Rajendra Kumar Shrestha, the then secretary of the Kathmandu District Committee, and Om Krishna Karmacharya, the then chairman of the Lalitpur District Committee. All three have already been arrested by the police. Similarly, cases have also been filed against the absconding Yuree Kumari Rai, the then chairperson, Deepakdas Shrestha, the then treasurer, Prayagraj Shrestha, the then treasurer, Bhagwan Shakya, the then chairperson, and Ramkrishna Chitrakar, the then advisor.

The then central chairperson of the organization, Rita Singh Vaidya, who played a key role in this case, has already passed away, so she has not been made a defendant. The case has been registered based on the report of the High-Level Investigation Commission, 2077, and the police investigation.

According to the CIB's investigation report, it was found that the then chairperson Rita Singh had taken Rs 7.5 million in cash by agreeing to rent out 29 ropanis of Bal Mandir land in Nakshal to Manoj Kumar Mishra without any public notice or competition. In addition, it has been found that the accused used funds from the treasury, which should have been spent for the benefit of children, for their own treatment, family bereavement expenses, and personal vehicle purchases.

In the vehicle purchase scam, it was found that Rajendra Kumar Shrestha bought a vehicle in his name and paid its installments from the Bal Mandir fund, and that vehicle was personally used by the then chairperson Bhagwan Shakya.

Furthermore, it has been found that Asha Shrestha continued to receive a monthly amount in the name of 'transport allowance' against the rules from Bal Mandir even after being elected to public office (ward member).
translated:
काठमांडू। नेपाल बाल संगठन (बाल मन्दिर) के जमीन आ सरकारी बजट के व्यक्तिगत लाभ के लेल दुरुपयोग क जालसाजी के आरोप मे 8 गोटे के खिलाफ काठमांडू जिल्ला न्यायालय मे मुकदमा दर्ज कराओल गेल अछि।

जिला सरकार के अटार्नी कार्यालय संस्था के तत्कालीन अधिकारी आ कर्मचारी पर अनाथ बच्चा के हित में उपयोग होबय वाला धन आ संपत्ति के गबन के आरोप लगाबैत आरोप पत्र दाखिल केलक अछि। प्रहरीके केन्द्रीय अनुसन्धान ब्यूरो (सीआईबी)के अनुसन्धान रिपोर्टके आधारमे धोखाधड़ीके आरोपमे काठमाण्डौ जिल्ला न्यायालयमे दायर कएल गेल अछि ।

मुकदमा चलै वाला मे बाल मंदिर के तत्कालीन योजना प्रमुख आ वर्तमान मे काठमांडू महानगरपालिका वडा नम्बर ११ के सदस्य आशा श्रेष्ठ, काठमांडू जिल्ला समिति के तत्कालीन सचिव राजेन्द्र कुमार श्रेष्ठ आ ललितपुर जिला समिति के तत्कालीन अध्यक्ष ओम कृष्ण कर्मचार्य शामिल छथि । तीनू गोटे के पुलिस गिरफ्तार क चुकल अछि। तहिना फरार यूरी कुमारी राय, तत्कालीन अध्यक्ष दीपकदास श्रेष्ठ, तत्कालीन कोषाध्यक्ष प्रयागराज श्रेष्ठ, तत्कालीन अध्यक्ष भगवान शाक्य, आ तत्कालीन सलाहकार रामकृष्ण चित्रकार पर सेहो मुकदमा दर्ज कएल गेल अछि ।

एहि मामला मे अहम भूमिका निभाबय वाली संस्थाक तत्कालीन केंद्रीय अध्यक्ष रीता सिंह वैद्यक निधन भ चुकल अछि, ताहि लेल हुनका प्रतिवादी नहि बनाओल गेल अछि। उच्च स्तरीय जांच आयोग के रिपोर्ट, 2077, आ पुलिस जांच के आधार पर मामला दर्ज कायल गेल अछि।

सीआईबी के जांच रिपोर्ट के अनुसार पता चलल जे तत्कालीन अध्यक्ष रीता सिंह नक्षल के बाल मंदिर के 29 रोपानी जमीन के मनोज कुमार मिश्र के बिना कोनो सार्वजनिक सूचना या प्रतिस्पर्धा के किराया पर देबय पर सहमत भ 75 लाख रुपया नगद ल गेल छलीह. एकरऽ अलावा ई भी पता चललै छै कि आरोपी न॑ कोषागार स॑ मिललऽ धनराशि के इस्तेमाल करलकै, जेकरा बच्चा सिनी के फायदा लेली खर्च करलऽ जाना चाहियऽ छेलै, अपनऽ इलाज, पारिवारिक शोक खर्च, आरू व्यक्तिगत वाहन खरीदै लेली ।

वाहन खरीद घोटाला मे पता चलल जे राजेन्द्र कुमार श्रेष्ठ हुनकर नाम पर एकटा वाहन कीनि ओकर किस्त बाल मंदिर कोष स देलथि, आ ओहि वाहन क व्यक्तिगत उपयोग तत्कालीन अध्यक्ष भगवान शाक्य केने छलाह।

संगहि, ई पाओल गेल अछि जे आशा श्रेष्ठ केँ सार्वजनिक पद (वार्ड सदस्य) मे निर्वाचित भेलाक बादो बाल मंदिर सँ नियमक विरुद्ध ‘परिवहन भत्ता’ केर नाम पर मासिक राशि भेटैत रहल।

title: CPN-UML Leader Thakur Gaire Questions Nepal's Diplomatic Operations and Government Role - Ratopati
description: CPN-UML Leader Thakur Gaire Questions Nepal's Diplomatic Operations and Government Role  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. CPN (UML) leader Thakur Gaire has raised questions about Nepal's current diplomatic operations and the government's role.

Expressing his views on social media Facebook, he expressed concern about the country's diplomatic situation and the confusion of state bodies.

Commenting on the current state of Nepal's diplomacy, leader Gaire wrote, 'Nepal's diplomacy today! What are the Prime Minister and the Prime Minister's Office doing? The Foreign Minister and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs seem to be unaware.' Expressing dissatisfaction with the government's working style, he claimed that the ruling party itself seems unaware of the government's activities.

Indicating the confusion of the parliament and citizens, he further wrote, 'Parliament, official state bodies, and the general public all seem to be in confusion, like a paper lost in the fog.'

Raising questions about whose signals the country's foreign policy and diplomacy are running on, Gaire added, 'A serious question has arisen, who is running Nepal's diplomacy? The government, the ministry, or some other invisible force?'

काठमांडू। नेकपा नेता ठाकुर गैरे नेपालक वर्तमान कूटनीतिक कार्यवाही आ सरकारक भूमिका पर सवाल उठौलनि अछि ।

सोशल मीडिया फेसबुक पर अपन विचार व्यक्त करैत ओ देश के कूटनीतिक स्थिति आ राज्य निकाय के भ्रम पर चिंता व्यक्त केलनि।

नेपालक कूटनीतिक वर्तमान स्थिति पर टिप्पणी करैत नेता गैरे लिखलनि, ‘नेपालक कूटनीति आइ! प्रधानमंत्री आ प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय की क' रहल अछि? विदेश मंत्री आ विदेश मंत्रालय अनभिज्ञ बुझाइत अछि।' सरकार के कार्यशैली स असंतोष व्यक्त करैत ओ दावा केलनि जे सत्ताधारी दल स्वयं सरकार के गतिविधि स अनभिज्ञ बुझाइत अछि।

संसद आरू नागरिकऽ के भ्रम के संकेत दैत॑ हुअ॑ हुनी आगू लिखलकै, 'संसद, आधिकारिक राज्य निकाय, आरू आम जनता सब भ्रम म॑ पड़लऽ नजर आबै छै, जेना कि कोहरा म॑ हेराय गेलऽ कागज ।'

देशक विदेश नीति आ कूटनीति केकर संकेत पर चलि रहल अछि ताहि पर सवाल उठबैत गैरे आगू कहलनि जे, ‘एकटा गंभीर प्रश्न उठल अछि, नेपालक कूटनीति के चला रहल अछि? सरकार, मंत्रालय, आकि कोनो आन अदृश्य शक्ति?'

title: Nepal schoolchildren in raincoats walk uphill hand-in-hand, sight is too cute to miss - India Today
description: Nepal schoolchildren in raincoats walk uphill hand-in-hand, sight is too cute to miss  India Today

full_article:
A man from Nepal spotted three tiny schoolchildren walking uphill in colourful raincoats, holding hands as they made their way through the rain, and the simple moment quickly won hearts online.

The video was shared by Instagram user Anil Bud, who captured the adorable sight while travelling and came across the children walking along a hilly road.

In the video, Bud was heard calling out to the young children after noticing them walking uphill together. Dressed in bright pink, yellow and green raincoats, the three schoolchildren walked side by side, with their little hands joined as they carefully made their way along the road.

title: Global rights groups raise concerns over Nepal’s judiciary - The Kathmandu Post
description: Global rights groups raise concerns over Nepal’s judiciary  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
International rights organisations have expressed concern over what they describe as growing political interference in Nepal’s judiciary, warning that recent government actions could undermine the independence of the courts and weaken the rule of law.



In a joint statement, Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, and the International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) stated that changes made to the Constitutional Council Act through an executive ordinance, along with reported pressure on senior Supreme Court justices, posed a serious threat to judicial independence.

The groups said the government’s decision in May to amend the Constitutional Council Act through an ordinance, rather than through parliamentary legislation, violated constitutional principles and raised concerns about the process for appointing officials to key constitutional bodies, including the chief justice.

The amendment changed the quorum and voting requirements of the Constitutional Council, the body responsible for recommending appointments to major constitutional positions. The rights organisations said the changes increased the possibility of political influence over judicial appointments because government representatives already hold a majority of seats on the council.

“The independence of the judiciary is a cornerstone of the rule of law and an essential safeguard for the protection of human rights,” Ian Seiderman, senior legal and policy director at the ICJ said in the statement. “Any reform of Nepal’s justice system should strengthen, not weaken, the independence, impartiality and integrity of the courts.”

The groups also questioned the appointment of Manoj Kumar Sharma as chief justice, saying it departed from Nepal’s long-standing practice of appointing the senior-most serving justice.

Although three senior judges remain on the Supreme Court, Sharma was appointed chief justice after being endorsed by the Parliamentary Hearing Committee. The organisations said complaints raised against his nomination were not subjected to meaningful public scrutiny.

The groups claimed that they had received credible reports that three senior Supreme Court justices, Sapana Pradhan Malla, Kumar Regmi and Hari Phuyal, had been pressured to resign under the threat of impeachment.

They said they were not aware of any publicly stated allegations against the judges that would meet the constitutional requirements for impeachment.

Under Nepal’s constitution, the initiation of impeachment proceedings automatically suspends a judge until Parliament determines whether the charges are valid. The organisations warned that suspending three senior Supreme Court justices could significantly affect the court’s functioning at a time when it is hearing important constitutional cases challenging government decisions and executive actions.

“Using or threatening to use impeachment against judges without clear constitutional justification risks creating the perception that constitutional procedures are being used to influence the composition of the court and potentially the outcome of pending cases,” the groups said.

They noted that Nepal has previously faced criticism over attempts to use impeachment proceedings against judges in ways that could compromise judicial independence.

“Public confidence in the judiciary depends not only on the competence and integrity of judges but also on the transparency, fairness and independence of judicial appointments,” said Meenakshi Ganguly, deputy Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “Appointments or removals that appear susceptible to political influence undermine confidence in the administration of justice and weaken the rule of law.”

International standards require judges to be protected from improper influence, pressure, threats and interference. The removal of judges must be based on objective criteria and safeguarded against political manipulation, the organisations said.

The groups acknowledged that judicial reform may be necessary in Nepal but said any reform process should strengthen institutional independence, transparency and accountability rather than increase political control over the judiciary.

“The objective of judicial reform should be to build stronger, more independent institutions that enjoy public confidence, not institutions that are more vulnerable to political pressure,” said Isabelle Lassee, acting regional director for South Asia at Amnesty International.

The organisations urged the Nepal government to stop “exerting pressure on judges to resign and avoid impeachment proceedings” unless there are clearly established constitutional grounds and due process safeguards.

They also called on authorities to ensure that judicial appointments, including the appointment of the chief justice, are conducted through transparent, objective and merit-based procedures.

The groups further urged Parliament to review amendments to the Constitutional Council Act through an open legislative process and ensure that future judicial reforms comply with Nepal’s constitution, the principles of separation of powers, and international standards on judicial independence.

एम्नेस्टी इंटरनेशनल, ह्यूमन राइट्स वॉच आरू इंटरनेशनल कमीशन आफ ज्यूरिस्ट (आईसीजे) न॑ एगो संयुक्त बयान म॑ कहलकै कि एगो कार्यकारी अध्यादेश के माध्यम स॑ संवैधानिक परिषद अधिनियम म॑ करलऽ गेलऽ बदलाव के साथ-साथ सुप्रीम कोर्ट केरऽ वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीशऽ प॑ दबाव के रिपोर्ट के साथ-साथ न्यायिक स्वतंत्रता लेली गंभीर खतरा छै ।

समूहऽ न॑ कहलकै कि मई म॑ सरकार केरऽ संसदीय कानून के माध्यम स॑ नै बल्कि अध्यादेश के माध्यम स॑ संवैधानिक परिषद अधिनियम म॑ संशोधन करै के फैसला संवैधानिक सिद्धांतऽ के उल्लंघन करै छै आरू मुख्य न्यायाधीश सहित प्रमुख संवैधानिक निकायऽ म॑ अधिकारियऽ के नियुक्ति के प्रक्रिया के बारे म॑ चिंता व्यक्त करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

संशोधन सँ प्रमुख संवैधानिक पद पर नियुक्ति के सिफारिश करय के जिम्मेवारी संवैधानिक परिषद् के कोरम आ मतदान के आवश्यकता मे बदलाव आयल अछि । अधिकार संगठन सब के कहनाय छनि जे एहि बदलाव सं न्यायिक नियुक्ति पर राजनीतिक प्रभाव के संभावना बढ़ल अछि किएक त परिषद मे सरकारी प्रतिनिधि के पास पहिने सं बहुमत अछि.

आईसीजे केरऽ वरिष्ठ कानूनी आरू नीति निदेशक इयान सेडरमैन न॑ बयान म॑ कहलकै कि न्यायपालिका केरऽ स्वतंत्रता कानून केरऽ राज केरऽ आधारशिला आरू मानव अधिकारऽ के सुरक्षा लेली एगो आवश्यक सुरक्षा छै । “नेपाल के न्याय व्यवस्था के कोनो सुधार न्यायालय के स्वतंत्रता, निष्पक्षता आ अखंडता के कमजोर नै, मजबूत करबाक चाही।”

समूह सब मनोज कुमार शर्मा के मुख्य न्यायाधीश के रूप में नियुक्ति पर सेहो सवाल उठेलक आ कहलक जे ई नेपाल के लंबा समय स चलल प्रथा स हटि गेल अछि जे ओ सबस वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीश के नियुक्ति करैत अछि।

हालांकि सुप्रीम कोर्ट मे तीनटा वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीश बनल छथि, मुदा संसदीय सुनवाई समिति क समर्थन क बाद शर्मा कए मुख्य न्यायाधीश नियुक्त कैल गेल। संस्था सब के कहनाय छनि जे हुनकर नामांकन के खिलाफ उठल शिकायत पर सार्थक जनजांच नहि कएल गेल अछि.

समूह सब के दावा छै कि ओकरा सब क॑ ई बात के विश्वसनीय रिपोर्ट मिललै कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट केरऽ तीन वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीश सपना प्रधान मल्ला, कुमार रेग्मी आरू हरि फुयाल प॑ महाभियोग के धमकी द॑ क॑ इस्तीफा दै के दबाव डाललऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ओ सब कहलनि जे, न्यायाधीश सब पर सार्वजनिक रूप स कोनो एहन आरोप के जानकारी नहि अछि जे महाभियोग के संवैधानिक आवश्यकता के पूरा करत।

नेपाल के संविधान के तहत महाभियोग के कार्यवाही शुरू भेला स कोनो न्यायाधीश के स्वतः निलंबित भ जायत अछि जा धरि संसद ई तय नै क लैत अछि जे आरोप वैध अछि कि नै। संगठन सब चेतावनी देलकै कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट केरऽ तीन वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीशऽ क॑ निलंबित करला स॑ कोर्ट केरऽ कामकाज प॑ काफी असर पड़॑ सकै छै, जब॑ कि ई सरकारी फैसला आरू कार्यकारी कार्रवाई क॑ चुनौती दै वाला महत्वपूर्ण संवैधानिक मामला के सुनवाई करी रहलऽ छै ।

समूह सब नँ कहलकै, “बिना स्पष्ट संवैधानिक औचित्य के न्यायाधीशौ के खिलाफ महाभियोग के उपयोग या उपयोग करै के धमकी देला स॑ ई धारणा पैदा होय के खतरा छै कि संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया के इस्तेमाल कोर्ट केरऽ संरचना आरू संभावित रूप स॑ लंबित मामला के परिणाम क॑ प्रभावित करै लेली करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै ।

ओ सब नोट केलथि जे नेपाल मे एहि सं पहिने न्यायाधीश के खिलाफ महाभियोग के कार्यवाही के एहन तरीका सं उपयोग करय के कोशिश के लsक आलोचना के सामना करय पड़ल अछि जाहि सं न्यायिक स्वतंत्रता सं समझौता भ सकय.

ह्यूमन राइट्स वॉच केरऽ उप एशिया निदेशक मीनाक्षी गांगुली न॑ कहलकै कि न्यायपालिका प॑ जनविश्वास खाली न्यायाधीशऽ के योग्यता आरू ईमानदारी प॑ ही नै बल्कि न्यायिक नियुक्ति के पारदर्शिता, निष्पक्षता आरू स्वतंत्रता प॑ भी निर्भर करै छै । “राजनीतिक प्रभाव के शिकार प्रतीत होय वाला नियुक्ति या हटाबै स॑ न्याय के प्रशासन प॑ विश्वास कमजोर होय जाय छै आरू कानून के राज कमजोर होय जाय छै।”

अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानक के अनुसार न्यायाधीश क॑ अनुचित प्रभाव, दबाव, धमकी आरू हस्तक्षेप स॑ बचाबै के जरूरत छै । न्यायाधीश सब के हटाबय के काज वस्तुनिष्ठ मानदंड के आधार पर होबाक चाही आ राजनीतिक हेरफेर स सुरक्षित हेबाक चाही संस्था सब कहलनि।

समूह सब नेपाल मे न्यायिक सुधार आवश्यक भ सकैत अछि से स्वीकार केलक मुदा कोनो सुधार प्रक्रिया न्यायपालिका पर राजनीतिक नियंत्रण बढ़ाबय के बजाय संस्थागत स्वतंत्रता, पारदर्शिता आ जवाबदेही के मजबूत करबाक चाही।

एम्नेस्टी इंटरनेशनल केरऽ दक्षिण एशिया केरऽ कार्यवाहक क्षेत्रीय निदेशक इसाबेल लसी न॑ कहलकै कि न्यायिक सुधार केरऽ उद्देश्य मजबूत, अधिक स्वतंत्र संस्थान के निर्माण होना होना चाहियऽ जेकरा म॑ जनविश्वास मिलै छै, न कि ऐसनऽ संस्था जे राजनीतिक दबाव के शिकार होय ।

संस्था सब नेपाल सरकार स आग्रह केलक जे जा धरि स्पष्ट रूप स स्थापित संवैधानिक आधार आ उचित प्रक्रिया क सुरक्षा नहि होएत ता धरि “न्यायाधीश पर इस्तीफा देबाक दबाव बनेनाइ आ महाभियोग क कार्यवाही स बचब” बंद करू।

हुनी अधिकारियौ स॑ ई भी आह्वान करलकै कि मुख्य न्यायाधीश केरऽ नियुक्ति सहित न्यायिक नियुक्ति पारदर्शी, वस्तुनिष्ठ आरू योग्यता आधारित प्रक्रिया के माध्यम स॑ करलऽ जाय ।

समूह सब आगू संसद स आग्रह केलक जे ओ खुला विधायी प्रक्रिया के माध्यम स संवैधानिक परिषद अधिनियम में संशोधन के समीक्षा करय आ भविष्य के न्यायिक सुधार नेपाल के संविधान, सत्ता के पृथक्करण के सिद्धांत, आ न्यायिक स्वतंत्रता के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानक के अनुपालन करय।

When Hira Shrestha of Khotang received the ‘Outstanding Woman Farmer’ award along with Rs 25,000 in cash on International Women’s Day 2025, she was overjoyed. “I was so happy to learn that farming in a village could also bring recognition,” she shared. Halesi Tuwachung Municipality had honored Hira for her contribution to marketing by growing vegetables and fruits in drought-ravaged fields. She is also grateful to the municipality for equipping her with irrigational and agricultural skills that helped her become an award-worthy farmer. “Had they not brought irrigation and agricultural training, there would have been no way to do commercial farming in this dry place,” she says.

Hira Shrestha with the certificate of honor. Photo - UNDP Nepal/ Robic Upadhyay

Despite having the Dudhkoshi and Sunkoshi rivers flowing next to the municipality, most of the land is drought-prone. In this municipality, the most drought-affected area in Khotang, there was a severe drinking water crisis until five years ago. But when elected representatives came to Halesi Tuwachung Municipality through the 2017 local level elections, they took on the responsibility of solving the drinking water problem. “Water had to be carried from far away, women and girls suffered greatly, lack of irrigation meant crops wouldn’t grow, food wasn’t enough for the whole year, and seasonal vegetables weren’t available,” recalls Mayor Bimala Rai, “we had to provide water to the people no matter what.” Bimala was the Deputy Mayor at that time. Local elected representatives had a comprehensive situation analysis of the municipality conducted in 2018. Through this, the reason for the water shortage in Halesi Tuwachung, situated at an elevation of up to 1,835 meters above sea level, was identified—due to low rainfall and steep rocky terrain, water ran off without underground recharge. This led to Halesi becoming the driest area in the entire district.” After discovering the cause of the drought, Halesi’s elected representatives began running to provincial and federal ministries to resolve the drinking water problem. The federal government listened heard their voices in 2020. Following that, a ‘Watershed-Based Climate Resilient Livelihoods' project was launched in collaboration with the Ministry of Forests and Environment and the United Nations Development Program (UNDP). The municipality and local residents became active in taking advantage of this project. Initially, water sources such as wells, stone spouts, and streams that were on the verge of disappearing in the area were revived through maintenance and repair. Locals got the opportunity to learn skills in rainwater harvesting for ponds, tunnels, and commercial farming along with fruit and vegetable seeds.

Dil Kumari Rai of Moli village in Okhaldhunga helps her neighbours cultivate crops inside a tunnel. Photo - UNDP Nepal/ Robic Upadhyay

Now many homes i the municipality have ponds to collect rainwater. Local farmers use the water collected in these ponds for drip irrigation to grow off-season vegetables. Due to this, they have succeeded in earning an income without having to leave their homes. Among them, 40-year-old Hira of Halesi Tuwachung Municipality-9 has established herself as a successful woman entrepreneur by engaging in commercial farming. Through this she also helped her husband avoid going abroad to support the family. In 2025, the Hira and Bharat earned Rs 200,000 from vegetable farming and an additional Rs 45,000 from raising livestock. “There has been a change in life that I never imagined,” says Hira, “since the municipality head is a woman herself, it is easier for us to ask for programs and plans, and we have been able to earn income from home.” Rice cultivation in the Majhi settlement of Halesi Tuwachung Municipality had not flourished due to a lack of sufficient water supply. However, the solar lifting irrigation introduced by UNDP's 'Developing Climate Resilient Livelihoods' has led to an increase in the production of rice. The municipality distributed corrugated iron sheets to 112 families whose roofs were unsuitable for building ponds and collecting water. This made rainwater harvesting easier.

Bimala Pariyar of Tinpiple in Okhaldhunga attending to her livestock. Photo - UNDP Nepal/ Robic Upadhyay

After water became available, the municipality has also distributed hand tractors to women in households whose male members have gone abroad or moved to cities. Additionally, buffaloes have been provided as subsidies under shed improvement support to increase agricultural yield. The combination of farming and animal husbandry has brought visible change to farmers’ lives. Halesi Tuwachung Municipalitys' Mayor Rai says "If the municipality had to do it alone, it would have been impossible to handle the technical aspects, commercial farming expansion, and community development all at once.” She says, “UNDP’s support has reduced that burden to zero.” Indeed, the project with a total cost of USD 7.9 million (more than Rs 1 billion) has benefited eight local units in Khotang and Okhaldhunga, including Halesi Tuwachung, which falls in the lower Dudhkoshi watershed area. A municipal-level agricultural strategic plan has also been prepared to continue the efforts initiated through the project. An agriculture mart and a cold storage center have been established in the Halesi market. An agro-vet center is in operation to diagnose diseases affecting crops, livestock, fertilizers, and seeds. Mayor Rai says, “The municipality works to fulfill whatever need exists here.” Good practices are being replicated The work done by municipalities is not limited to just one place or area. Local governments have replicated the good practices in various parts of the country. Six years ago, a 380-kilowatt hydropower plant built under a renewable energy program for rural livelihoods on the Tara Khola in Baglung district with support from UNDP brought electricity access to more than 2,000 households in Tara Khola Rural Municipality. However, when consumers had to walk for hours to reach the office to pay electricity bills due to geographical difficulties, some found it burdensome. For the convenience of the community members, smart electricity meters were been installed in coordination between the rural municipality and the electricity office. The electricity office installed meters in every consumer’s home and the rural municipality appointed sub-dealers in all wards for recharge card distribution. Due to this, for the first time in the district, Tara Khola hydropower consumers have received smart recharge meters at home. Om Gharti of Sip village, Tara Khola-5, says, “We no longer have to rush to pay 100/200 rupee bills. Our village has city-like facilities.”

Women in Tara Khola work on a potato chips factory powered by the 380-kilowatt Tara Khola hydropower plant. Photo - UNDP Nepal/ Suraj Ratna Shakya

अंतरराष्ट्रीय महिला दिवस 2025 पर खोटांग के हीरा श्रेष्ठ के जखन ‘उत्कृष्ट महिला किसान’ पुरस्कार के संग 25 हजार रुपैया नगद भेटल त हुनका बहुत खुशी भेल। ओ साझा केलनि जे, ई जानि कए हमरा एतेक खुशी भेल जे कोनो गाम मे खेती सेहो पहचान ल सकैत अछि। हलेसी तुवाचुंग नगरपालिका रौदीसँ तबाह खेतमे तरकारी आ फल उगाबैत विपणनमे हिराके योगदानक लेल सम्मानित केने छल । ओ नगरपालिका के सेहो आभारी छथि जे हुनका सिंचाई आ कृषि कौशल स लैस केलक जे हुनका पुरस्कृत किसान बनय मे मदद केलक। ओ कहैत छथि जे अगर ओ सब सिंचाई आ कृषि प्रशिक्षण नहि अनने रहितथि त एहि शुष्क जगह पर व्यावसायिक खेती करबाक कोनो तरीका नहि रहैत।

नगरपालिकाक बगलमे दुधकोशी आ सुनकोशी नदी बहैत रहलाक बादो अधिकांश जमीन रौदीक प्रवण अछि । खोटांग के सबस बेसी रौदी प्रभावित इलाका एहि नगरपालिका मे पांच साल पहिने तक पेयजल के भयंकर संकट छल। लेकिन २०१७ के स्थानीय तह के चुनाव के माध्यम स॑ जब॑ निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि हलेसी तुवाचुंग नगरपालिका म॑ ऐलै त॑ पेयजल के समस्या के समाधान के जिम्मेदारी लेलकै । मेयर विमला राय स्मरण करैत कहैत छथि, “पानि दूर सँ ल’ जेबाक छल, महिला आ लड़की केँ बहुत नुकसान भेल, सिंचाईक अभाव मे फसल नहि उगय लागल, साल भरि लेल भोजन पर्याप्त नहि छल, आ मौसमी तरकारी नहि भेटैत छल, हमरा लोकनि केँ लोक केँ पानि उपलब्ध कराबय पड़ल चाहे किछुओ हो।” ओहि समय मे विमला डिप्टी मेयर छलीह। स्थानीय निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि सब के पास 2018 में नगरपालिका के व्यापक स्थिति विश्लेषण छेलै.एकर माध्यम स॑ समुद्र तल स॑ १,८३५ मीटर तलक के ऊंचाई प॑ स्थित हलेसी तुवाचुंग म॑ पानी के कमी के कारण के पहचान करलऽ गेलै-कम बारिश आरू खड़ी चट्टानी इलाका के कारण बिना भूमिगत रिचार्ज के पानी भागी गेलै । एहि सँ हलेसी पूरा जिला मे सबसँ शुष्क क्षेत्र बनि गेल।” सूखा के कारण के पता चलला के बाद हलेसी के निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि पेयजल के समस्या के समाधान के लेल प्रांतीय आ संघीय मंत्रालय में दौड़य लगलाह. संघीय सरकार 2020 मे सुनल गेल ओकर आवाज सुनलक.एकर बाद वन आ पर्यावरण मंत्रालय आ संयुक्त राष्ट्र विकास कार्यक्रम (यूएनडीपी) कें सहयोग सं ‘जल विभाजन आधारित जलवायु लचीला आजीविका’ परियोजना शुरू कैल गेलय. एहि परियोजना क लाभ उठाबय मे नगरपालिका आ स्थानीय निवासी सक्रिय भ गेल। शुरू में जल स्रोत जेना इनार, पाथर के टोंटी, आ धारक जे एहि इलाका में गायब होय के कगार पर छल, ओकरा रखरखाव आ मरम्मत के माध्यम सं पुनर्जीवित कयल गेल. स्थानीय लोक के फल-सब्जी के बीज के संग-संग पोखरि... सुरंग, आओर व्यावसायिक खेती के लेल बरसात के पानि संचय के हुनर सीखय के मौका मिलल.

ओखलढुंगा के मोली गाम के दिल कुमारी राय अपन पड़ोसी के सुरंग के अंदर फसल के खेती में मदद करैत छैथ। फोटो - यूएनडीपी नेपाल/ रोबिक उपाध्याय

आब कतेको घर i नगरपालिका मे बरसातक पानि जमा करबाक लेल पोखरि अछि । स्थानीय किसान अइ पोखरि मे एकत्रित पानी कें उपयोग ड्रिप इरिगेशन कें लेल ऑफ सीजन तरकारी कें खेती कें लेल करय छै. एकरऽ वजह स॑ घरऽ स॑ बाहर नै निकललऽ आय कमाबै म॑ सफल होय गेलऽ छै । एहि मे हलेसी तुवाचुंग नगरपालिका–९ के ४० वर्षीय हीरा व्यावसायिक खेती मे लागि सफल महिला उद्यमी के रूप मे अपना के स्थापित केने छथि । एहि माध्यमे ओ अपन पति कए सेहो परिवार क भरण-पोषण लेल विदेश जेबा स बचबा मे मदद केलथि। 2025 मे हीरा आ भारत कए सब्जी खेती स दू लाख आ पशुपालन स अतिरिक्त 45 हजार टका क कमाई भेल। हीरा कहैत छथि, “जीवन मे एहन बदलाव आयल अछि जेकर कल्पना हम कहियो नहि केने रही, चूँकि नगरपालिका प्रमुख स्वयं महिला छथि, ताहि लेल हमरा सब लेल कार्यक्रम आ योजना मांगब आसान भ गेल अछि, आ घर बैसल आमदनी सेहो भ सकल अछि।” हलेसी तुवाचुङ नगरपालिकाके माझी बस्तीमे पर्याप्त जल आपूर्तिके अभावमे धानक खेती पनपने नहि छल । लेकिन यूएनडीपी केरऽ ‘विकसित जलवायु लचीला आजीविका’ द्वारा शुरू करलऽ गेलऽ सौर उत्थान सिंचाई के वजह स॑ चावल केरऽ उत्पादन म॑ वृद्धि होय गेलऽ छै । नगरपालिका 112 परिवार के नालीदार लोहा के चादर वितरित केलक जेकर छत पोखरि बनेबा आ पानि संग्रहण के लेल अनुपयुक्त छल। एहि स बरसात क पानि क संग्रहण मे आसानी भ गेल।

ओखलढुंगा के तिनपिपल के बिमला परियार अपन पशुधन के देखभाल करैत। फोटो - यूएनडीपी नेपाल/ रोबिक उपाध्याय

पानि मिलला के बाद नगरपालिका ओहि घर मे महिला के हाथ ट्रैक्टर सेहो वितरण केने अछि जकर पुरुष सदस्य विदेश गेल अछि या शहर चलि गेल अछि। एकर अतिरिक्त कृषि पैदावार मे वृद्धि कें लेल शेड सुधार समर्थन कें तहत सब्सिडी कें रूप मे भैंस कें उपलब्ध करायल गेल छै. खेती आ पशुपालन के संयोजन स किसान के जीवन में दृश्यमान परिवर्तन आयल अछि | हलेसी तुवाचुंग नगरपालिकाक मेयर राय कहैत छथि "जँ नगरपालिका केँ असगर करय पड़ितैक त' तकनीकी पहलू, वाणिज्यिक खेती विस्तार, आ सामुदायिक विकास केँ एकहि बेर मे सम्हारब असंभव रहैत।" ओ कहैत छथि, “यूएनडीपी के समर्थन सं ओ बोझ शून्य भ गेल अछि.” दरअसल, कुल 79 लाख डॉलर (1 अरब रुपया स॑ भी अधिक) के लागत वाला ई परियोजना स॑ खोटांग आरू ओखलढुंगा केरऽ आठ स्थानीय इकाइयऽ क॑ फायदा मिललऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ हलेसी तुवाचुंग भी शामिल छै, जे निचला दुधकोशी जल विभाजन क्षेत्र म॑ पड़ै छै । एहि परियोजना क माध्यम स शुरू कैल गेल प्रयास कए जारी रखबा लेल नगर स्तरीय कृषि रणनीतिक योजना सेहो तैयार कैल गेल अछि। हलेसी बाजार मे कृषि मार्ट आ कोल्ड स्टोरेज सेंटर क स्थापना कैल गेल अछि। फसल, पशुधन, खाद, आ बीज कें प्रभावित करएय वाला बीमारियक कें निदान कें लेल एकटा एग्रो-वेट सेंटर संचालित छै. मेयर राय कहैत छथि, “नगरपालिका एतय जे आवश्यकता अछि ओकरा पूरा करबाक काज करैत अछि।” नीक प्रथाक नकल भ रहल अछि नगरपालिका द्वारा कयल गेल काज मात्र एक स्थान वा क्षेत्र धरि सीमित नहि अछि । स्थानीय सरकार देश के विभिन्न भाग मे नीक प्रथा के नकल केलक अछि। छह साल पहिने यूएनडीपी के सहयोग सं बागलुंग जिला के तारा खोला पर ग्रामीण आजीविका के लेल अक्षय ऊर्जा कार्यक्रम के तहत बनल 380 किलोवाट के जलविद्युत संयंत्र तारा खोला ग्रामीण नगरपालिका के 2000 सं बेसी घर के बिजली पहुंच पहुंचा देलक. मुदा जखन भौगोलिक दिक्कत के कारण उपभोक्ता के बिजली के बिल भरय लेल ऑफिस पहुंचय लेल घंटों पैदल चलय पड़ल त किछ लोक के ई बोझिल लागल. समुदाय के सदस्य के सुविधा के लेल ग्रामीण नगरपालिका आ विद्युत कार्यालय के बीच समन्वय स स्मार्ट बिजली मीटर लगाओल गेल। बिजली कार्यालय हर उपभोक्ता के घर मे मीटर लगा देलक आ ग्रामीण नगरपालिका रिचार्ज कार्ड वितरण के लेल सब वार्ड मे सब डीलर नियुक्त केलक। एकर कारण जिला मे पहिल बेर तारा खोला जलविद्युत उपभोक्ता कए घर मे स्मार्ट रिचार्ज मीटर भेटल अछि। सिप गाम तारा खोला-5 के ओम घरती कहैत छथि, “हमरा सब के आब 100/200 रुपया के बिल देबय लेल हड़बड़ी नहि करय पड़ैत अछि, हमर गाम में शहर सन सुविधा अछि।”

तारा खोला के महिला 380 किलोवाट के तारा खोला जलविद्युत संयंत्र सं संचालित आलू के चिप्स फैक्ट्री मे काज करैत छथिन्ह. फोटो - यूएनडीपी नेपाल/ सूरज रत्न शाक्य

Kathmandu, July 24: Swiss Ambassador to Nepal, Dr Danielle Meuwly, paid a courtesy call on Vice President Ram Sahay Prasad Yadav today.

During the meeting held at the Office of the Vice President, Lainchour, they discussed the various dimensions of bilateral relations between Nepal and Switzerland, according to the Secretariat of the Vice-President.

Stating that Nepal and Switzerland are always enjoying cordial, friendly relations since the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries in 1956, Vice President Yadav underlined that high-level visits between the two countries have further strengthened the relations.

VP Yadav also extended gratitude towards constant support and harmony of Swiss government in Nepal's peace process, expressing pleasure for keeping Nepal in the priority of Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation.

Similarly, the Swiss Ambassador stressed the need of further strengthening diplomatic relations between Nepal and Switzerland, adding that the Swiss government is willing to invest in Nepal's different sectors including industry.(RSS)

Stricter Eligibility for Everest Climbers

If the bill is approved, the new law would significantly raise the bar for aspiring Everest climbers by requiring them to first prove their high-altitude mountaineering experience before obtaining a permit.

One of the biggest changes in the proposed legislation is that climbers would need to successfully summit at least one mountain above 7,000 metres in Nepal before becoming eligible for an Everest permit. The move is intended to ensure that only experienced climbers attempt the world’s tallest mountain.

The proposal also includes stricter regulations for expedition operators and guides. High-altitude guides accompanying climbers on Everest would be required to be Nepali citizens, a measure designed to promote local expertise and improve safety standards on expeditions.

The reforms come in response to growing criticism over overcrowding on Everest. During the latest spring climbing season, Nepal issued 492 climbing permits, resulting in 1,008 successful ascents from the Nepal side for the first time in history.

Long queues near the summit have become a recurring concern, with climbers often forced to wait in the so-called “death zone", where oxygen levels are extremely low. Experts have repeatedly warned that congestion, combined with inexperienced climbers, can increase the risk of accidents and fatalities.

Impact on Nepal’s Tourism Industry

Mountaineering is a major contributor to Nepal’s tourism economy, with Everest attracting climbers from across the globe every year. However, balancing tourism revenue with environmental protection and climber safety has become increasingly challenging as commercial expeditions continue to grow.

full_article:
Samsung Nepal has announced the successful completion of the latest Samsung Innovation Campus (SIC) Coding & Programming programme and opened applications for a new Artificial Intelligence (AI) course, strengthening its commitment to developing Nepal’s next generation of digital talent.

The Coding & Programming course under SIC, conducted from December 22, 2025, to June 30, 2026, equipped students with hands-on technical skills, practical project experience and industry exposure. Graduates were honoured at a ceremony recognising their successful completion of the programme.

“When I attended Samsung Innovation Campus shortly after arriving in Nepal last December, I saw tremendous potential in Nepal’s young talent. Today, I am proud to see that potential turning into real achievement. As artificial intelligence reshapes every industry, developing digital talent is more important than ever. Through Samsung Innovation Campus, Samsung is equipping young people with the skills, confidence and innovative mindset to help lead Nepal’s digital future,” said Chang Uk Jung, Managing Director, Samsung Nepal.

Launched in Nepal in 2023 under Samsung’s global CSR vision, “Together for Tomorrow! Enabling People,” Samsung Innovation Campus equips young people with industry-relevant skills in emerging technologies while strengthening essential workplace capabilities such as communication, collaboration and critical thinking.

The new AI programme comes as artificial intelligence is transforming industries and creating demand for a new generation of digital professionals. Designed around practical learning and real-world applications, the course will help participants build AI capabilities while encouraging innovation to address Nepal’s evolving development needs.

Beyond the classroom, Samsung Nepal will continue supporting graduates through mentorship from Samsung employees and industry experts, innovation projects and career guidance. The company also plans to establish a Samsung Innovation Campus Alumni Network, enabling graduates to stay connected, continue learning and mentor future participants.

Samsung believes stronger collaboration between academia, industry and government will be essential to building Nepal’s AI ecosystem, expanding career opportunities and accelerating the country’s digital transformation.

KATHMANDU: Police said 47 foreign women have been deported from Nepal for allegedly engaging in prostitution.

The District Police Range, Kathmandu, disclosed the information during a press conference on Friday.

Speaking at the briefing, Superintendent of Police (SP) Pawan Kumar Bhattarai said 57 foreign women were detained during a special operation in tourist areas, including Thamel and Durbar Marg, on suspicion of involvement in prostitution.

Of those detained, 47 have been deported through the Department of Immigration, while investigations into the remaining 10 are ongoing, he said.

Press Release

The Third Meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism (BCM) concluded in Kathmandu today.

The two sides reviewed the status of Nepal- Australia bilateral relations and deliberated on matters of mutual interests.

Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to translating the understandings reached between the two sides into tangible outcomes for the mutual benefit of both countries.

They reviewed bilateral cooperation and development assistance, focusing on priorities such as high-level political engagement, climate resilience, green economy, water resource management, agricultural research, and the alignment of Australia's Development Partnership Plan in line with Nepal's national priorities.

The BCM highlighted various areas of cooperation, including the expansion of trade relations, air connectivity, tourism, investment in Nepal's hydropower sector and the establishment of a formal educational cooperation framework for education and research.

The meeting also focused on strengthening people-to-people links by leveraging diaspora networks, managing migration and visa frameworks and exploring sister-city relations.

Both sides also exchanged views on regional and international trends, human rights, carbon trading frameworks and reciprocal support for candidacies in multilateral forums like the United Nations.

The meeting was co-chaired by Mr Amrit Bahadur Rai, Foreign Secretary of the Ministry and H. E. Ms Sarah Storey, First Assistant Secretary of the South and Central Asia Division at the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) of Australia.

The Australian delegation comprised Ms Margot Holt, Policy Officer (DFAT); Mr Simon Ernst, Head of Mission and Mr Greg Klemm, Deputy Head of Mission at the Australian Embassy in Kathmandu; Mr Dylan Jones-Virma, First Secretary Development at the Australian Embassy; Mr Steven Biddle, Regional Director for South Asia at the Department of Home Affairs; Lt Col Fiona Bruce, Army Adviser / Brigadier Damian Hill, Head of Australian DefenceStaff; and Mr George Thiveos, Minister-Counsellor (Education and Research) at the Australian High Commission in India.

The Nepali side consisted of Mr. Prakash Adhikari, Joint Secretary and Head of the South-East Asia and the Pacific Division from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; Mr Dhani Ram Sharma, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Finance; Mr Ananda Kafle, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs; Mr Buddha Bahadur Gurung, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies; Dr Hari Bahadur KC, Joint Secretary, and Dr Rajendra KC, Joint Secretary from the Ministry of Agriculture, Forests and Environment; Mr Shiva Kumar Sapkota, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Education and Sports; Mr. Jeebachh Mandal, Joint Secretary, Water and Energy Commission Secretariat; Mr. Narayan Prasad Wagle and Mr. Binod Mukhiya, Under Secretaries and Mr Hemant Timilsina, Section Officer from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Similarly, the first meeting of Joint Nepal-Australia Trade and Investment Committee under the Nepal Australia Trade and Investment Framework Arrangement (TIFA) was held in Kathmandu, yesterday.

The Bilateral Consultation Mechanism between Nepal and Australia was established in July 2017. The first and second meeting of the Mechanism were held in Kathmandu and Canberra in 2018 and 2022 respectively.

title: Great expectations - Nepali Times
description: Great expectations  Nepali Times
publisher.title: Nepali Times
full_article:
The RSP swept the election four month ago, benefiting from widespread public disillusionment with the past 20 years of misrule and poor governance by the old parties.

That was a vote for a departure from the past. And there were great expectations. Expectations can be unrealistic, but they stem from the hope. Decades of political dysfunction cannot be solved in months, but there are now signs of impatience in the public.

There are many who want to give this government a chance to set things right, but its high-handedness is putting too many people off.

Prime Minister Balendra Shah's government and his advisers seem to be resorting to distraction and deflection. Balendra Shah expected to win, but not with such a huge majority, so he is letting his advisers behave in the only way they know how — with tough talk, intimidation, and bypassing due process.

Instead of strengthening coordination and communication between line agencies, members of the PMO have been acting like a parallel government.

A widely-circulated investigation in setopati.com by editor Ameet Dhakal has meticulously detailed how the prime minister’s inner circle threatened officials, including the DG of the Passport Department Tirtha Raj Aryal and its IT director Sunil KC to cancel German e-passport deal. The CIAA chief Prem Kumar Rai was held hostage for hours in a PMO anteroom.

Also present were Foreign Secretary Amrit Rai and German Ambassador Udo Eugen Volz who were needlessly questioned and harassed for hours, Dhakal quoted sources as saying. Even when reminded that it would cost the country dearly, diplomatically and legally, they ordered proceedings against two German companies and 15 others.

Last year, the Nepal government awarded German companies Veridos GmbH and Mühlbauer ID Services a five-year contract worth Rs10.13 billion to arrange 6.4 million e-passports. The Department of Passports is alleged to have manipulated the procurement process to award the contract to the Germans.

The French company IDEMIA supplied Nepal’s machine-readable passports and e-passports until last year, losing the bid to Veridos GmbH and Mühlbauer ID Services after 17 years. IDEMIA challenged the decision in court but the Public Procurement Review Committee dismissed it. The French firm itself is alleged to have bypassed the Public Procurement Act through bribery, and the action against the Germans is seen as a retribution for losing the contract.

‘The way constitutional officials and state administrators were berated exceeding all constitutional bounds inside the Prime Minister's Office on 15 June over the passport procurement case is a troubling sign of a government run by a tight inner circle,” Dhakal later wrote in an editorial.

He continued: “By discarding established governance norms and democratic principles, the Prime Minister’s Secretariat operated like a shadow cabinet. Its chief qualification wasn't administrative competence, but the blind impulse of populism and an arrogant 'we know it all' mindset.”

The prime minister’s vocal supporters have applauded his move to thumb its nose at what they believe was a tainted deal by a previous government. They blame the messenger for exposing the bungling.

Bypassing the Foreign Ministry and acting without constitutional jurisdiction or formal expertise has harmed Nepal’s credibility in the international arena, and shown once again how feckless and fickle the PM’s advisers have been.

Evidence is growing that Balendra Shah and his kitchen cabinet are working to undermine the state mechanism, driven partly by their belief that two-thirds is mandate to uproot everything.

From the eviction of squatters to bungling international relations, Nepal is paying too high a price for signs of change that ordinary citizens have not yet seen. The last straw for many was the 3% equity tax on private healthcare and education. The prime minister appears to have read the writing on the wall and rolled it back (page 1).

The government had also proposed the Vehicle and Transport Management Bill, which introduced significantly harder penalties for traffic violations with fines up to Rs100,000, before the self-immolation of Ganesh Nepali after repeated traffic fines for illegal parking. To deflect scrutiny, supporters of the Balendra Shah government illegally parked their cars in front of select media houses, an act later condemned by their own party.

These recent cases show that one hand of government doesn’t know what the other hand is doing. Nearly four months into the RSP government, the cracks in the party’s formidable armour are beginning to show.

Everything came to a head this week with fresh rumours of the prime minister preparing to sack Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle over ideological and policy differences. Wagle’s equity tax was ill-advised in a country where those seeking private schools or hospitals are not necessarily the wealthy.

The Rabi-Swarnim chat at the Dustin Thani seems to have resolved the issue for now. It now remains to be seen how long party chair Rabi Lamichhane can keep doing damage control and keep the RSP together for the next five years. There are seemingly irreconcilable differences in personality and working style between the party and the PMO.

Feedback about international relations seems to be getting across to the prime minister who is finally meeting Indian and Chinese envoys separately later this week. He has also been holding consultations with the business sector.

The hope is that the PMO and the RSP will come together as they did during the election campaign and show greater accountability for their own good. Failure is not an option for the country, either.
